# Xarmoured

> Xarmoured is an India-based, remote-first offensive security practice. It provides manual-first penetration testing for web applications, APIs and Android applications, with evidence-led reporting, remediation guidance and retesting to confirm fixes.

Xarmoured does not publish invented clients, certifications, testimonials or results. Findings are validated manually and reported with reproducible evidence. To request a scoped assessment, use https://www.xarmoured.tech/assessment/.

## Services
- [Web Application Penetration Testing](https://www.xarmoured.tech/services/web-application-penetration-testing/): authentication, session handling, access control (IDOR), business logic and injection testing.
- [API Security Testing](https://www.xarmoured.tech/services/api-security-testing/): BOLA/IDOR, function-level authorization, JWT and session flows, mass assignment and SSRF.
- [Android Application Security Testing](https://www.xarmoured.tech/services/mobile-application-security-testing/): APK analysis, exported components, local storage, traffic handling and backend API trust boundaries.
- [Retesting and Remediation Validation](https://www.xarmoured.tech/services/retesting-remediation-validation/): re-running original attack paths to confirm a fix works.
